description: The National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) Fed PAC, the nation's leading small business advocacy organization, today announced its endorsement of Monique DeSpain, the Republican candidate for Oregon's 4th Congressional District, marking the second consecutive election cycle NFIB Fed PAC has backed her campaign.

title: NFIB Endorses Monique DeSpain for Congress, Citing Her Record as a Champion for Small Business - Monique DeSpain for Congress
